title: Mathematics II — Textbook for Grade XI (Egyptian Baccalaureate, 2nd Year), Part One, English
subject: math
lesson_titles_note: Egyptian Baccalaureate, Grade 11 (2nd year) Mathematics, Part One (Ministry of Education and Technical Education, 2026; 204 pages: 4 chapters, 18 concepts). A book of its own, ingested from its PDF by the book-record pipeline (Tamer, 2026-10-21, branch egy-bac-g11-maths-ingestion). Its course, course:egb-g11-math-en, and its curriculum, eg-baccalaureate-en, are not yet in the app (app/src/lib/courses.ts, curricula.ts): nothing is shown to students until they are added. Lesson slugs are eb11c<chapter>-<concept>. Part Two is a separate PDF, not yet received. Each concept is printed as numbered sections (1-1 … 4-26, 88 in all), and every section prints its Learning Outcomes: those are the objectives (objectives_mode printed), about five per lesson. Lesson titles, page offsets and units come from its own S0 lesson map, approved at G0.
